goal: Iske baad aap aisa array bana sakte hain jis ka size user run time par type kare, usay aam array ki tarah use kar sakte hain, delete[] se free kar sakte hain, aur bade array mein copy kar ke usay barha sakte hain.
warmup: Canteen ke malik ko nahi pata ke aaj lunch par kitne students aayenge. 100 plates ki fixed list jagah zaya karti hai, aur 20 plates kam ho sakti hain. Samajhdar malik pehle class ginta hai, phir bilkul utni hi plates lagata hai. Dynamic array bhi yehi karta hai: woh intezar karta hai jab tak program ko size pata na chal jaye, phir bilkul utne boxes allocate karta hai.
definition: Aam array ka size code mein likha hona zaroori hai, masalan int a[10]. Dynamic array ko apna size program chalte waqt milta hai: int *a = new int[n]; jahan n cin se aa sakta hai. new[] heap par ek ke baad ek n boxes banata hai aur pehle box ka address wapas deta hai. Aap usay pointer mein rakhte hain. Aap a[i] ko bilkul aam array ki tarah use karte hain. Jab aap kaam khatam kar lein to poore array ko delete[] a; se free karte hain (arrays ke liye brackets zaroori hain).
howItWorks: Pehle size n parhein. Phir int *a = new int[n]; likhein. Pointer a stack par ek chhota variable hai. n boxes heap par saath saath hain, to a[0] pehla, a[1] doosra, aur a[i] ka matlab *(a + i) jaisa hi hai. Array ko aam for loops se fill aur print karein. Hamesha range 0 se n-1 ke andar rahein. Aakhir mein usay delete[] a; se free karein aur a = nullptr; kar dein. Zaroori jodi: new ke saath delete, new[] ke saath delete[]. Inhein mix karna undefined behaviour hai. Heap array wahin par bada nahi ho sakta. Usay bada karne ke liye: (1) naya bada array allocate karein, (2) purani values copy karein, (3) purane array ko delete[] karein, (4) pointer ko naye array par point karwa dein. Two-dimensional dynamic array sirf ek variation hai: pointers ka array allocate karein (int **g = new int*[rows];), phir har row ko new int[cols] se apna int array dein, aur free karte waqt pehle har row, phir pointers ka array free karein.
